hero.caption: When selecting dates, look for plump, evenly colored specimens. All dates have a single long seed, but they can range in shape from oblong to round, depending on the cultivar. The date should not look dry or withered, and no crystals should appear on the exterior of the date. Fresh dates will last for up to two weeks under refrigeration, while preserved dates can last much longer, depending on how they are preserved.

images.caption:
Southern California may be full of palm trees, but rarely are they seen in a concentrated, un-landscaped forest, like this.

Shields Date Palm Garden is a roadside attraction located on Hwy 111 in Indio, the eastern end of Coachella Valley.
